answer: Positioning is the problem with the long: the crowd is already long the euro, so the marginal buyer is missing. Candidates are a flat book or a short into the week; the pick is flat, because a short against a supportive rate path is a crowded trade. The range is a pullback of one to two percent, at low coverage, and it is the disagreement that matters.

claims.text: Positioning surveys show the crowd long the euro
A crowded long has no marginal buyer left
A short against a supportive rate path is crowded too
